payload.title: Stop SNS email on Papyrus alarms
payload.description:
**Milestone:** M2, operators finished

**Goal.** Alarms stay; they reach Caducus through the forwarder already, whatever their actions. This removes the email path once Caducus has been seen to work.

**Build.**
Remove the email subscription and alarm actions in `infra/monitoring/papyrus-monitoring.yaml` (a hand-run stack), `infra/scheduled-jobs/lib/scheduled-container-job.ts` and its `alarmEmailParameter` (update `docs/knowledge-cloud-run.md`, `docs/knowledge-runs-rollout.md`), the remote-login alarms and `alarmTopicArn` (`docs/cli-login.md`, and close PPY-45efff), `amplify/publication/invalidation-alarm.ts`, `reproject-on-deploy.ts`, `infra/email/papyrus-email-submissions.yaml`. One PR. Do it after Ryan says the parallel run was good. Machine-only topics are P_SESEB. Gherkin: `infra/scheduled-jobs/features/scheduled-container-job.feature` changes with it.

**Acceptance.**
A forced alarm reaches Ryan once, through Caducus, and no SNS email comes. Site bumps batched; a release with no site effect marked so.

**Related:** kanbus-6275db, kanbus-78f229
